comment: The Declared Target ratchet baseline for tools/scripts/check-nx-declared-targets.mjs (`yarn nx:targets:check`). Every baseline entry is a target on an @nx/* executor Nx has deprecated in favour of an inferred plugin that project.json still declares instead of leaving to Nx's Inferred Targets; the list can only shrink as later slices remove overrides (ADR 0082, sharpened by ADR 0083; PRD #762). A target present here with no matching project.json entry fails the check as stale — remove it in the same change that removes the override. A target found on the tree but absent here fails the check as a new Declared Target. `notDebt` names an @nx/* executor Nx still ships as its own answer: each entry is its own decision, so it carries a reason and a source, and an entry covering no target fails as stale.

notDebt.reason: Serves a built Node app with rebuild-and-restart. The Nx 23 release deprecates the per-tool executors that inferred plugins replace and does not name @nx/js:node, and Nx 22.7.7's own @nx/node application generator still emits it for serve alongside an inferred webpack build; @nx/webpack/plugin's inferred serve is webpack-cli serve, a browser dev server, which cannot replace it.
